text: {"name":"rf_calib_params_get","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Builds a parameter report in the caller's buffer from the selected RF calibration context, advances its sequence counter, and records the number of emitted entries.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v2":"calib_context_table","v3":"calib_context","v4":"sequence_number","v5":"status_flags","v8":"calib_record","v9":"output_record","v10":"record_count"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Per-record active/valid byte; records are 48 bytes apart."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Per-record byte copied to the serialized entry."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Per-record 64-bit payload copied to the serialized entry."},{"offset":32,"meaning":"Per-record selector/state byte, compared with 1 when filtering entries."},{"offset":33,"meaning":"Per-record filtering or validity byte."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Per-record 32-bit value added to the difference of global reference values in the output."},{"offset":115,"meaning":"Context status byte reflected in the output flags."},{"offset":120,"meaning":"Context sequence counter, copied to the output and then incremented."},{"offset":135,"meaning":"Context filtering-enable byte used when deciding whether to emit records."},{"offset":136,"meaning":"Context field updated with the emitted record count."},{"offset":1,"meaning":"Output length field derived from the number of emitted entries."},{"offset":7,"meaning":"Second output length field derived from the number of emitted entries."},{"offset":9,"meaning":"Output sequence number byte."},{"offset":10,"meaning":"Output status/validity flags byte."},{"offset":11,"meaning":"Start of packed 13-byte output entries."}]}
